_comment: Copy this file to scripts/config.json and fill in your values. config.json is git-ignored.

trading._comment: Sub-account (or main account) API keys used for placing orders

broker._comment: Master account API keys — used for sub-account management and fund transfers. Requires 'Enable Reading' + 'Allow Universal Transfer' permissions. NOT the sub-account trading key.

orderDefaults._comment: Default values pre-filled in the interactive form

subAccounts._comment: Display labels for sub-accounts shown in the 'List Sub-accounts' screen. Use the email address (NOT a numeric ID).
subAccounts.label: Bot Account 1

transferRules._comment: Use sub-account email address for 'from'/'to'. Use 'master' for the master account. Emails are shown in 'List Sub-accounts' screen.
transferRules._comment1: PATTERN 1: Pull excess from sub-account to master when balance exceeds threshold
transferRules.label: Pull excess from Sub1 to master

transferRules._comment: PATTERN 2: Top-up sub-account from master when balance drops below threshold
transferRules.label: Top-up Sub2 from master when low

transferRules._comment: PATTERN 3: Sub-account to sub-account — fixed amount each run
transferRules.label: Sub1 → Sub2 fixed transfer

transferRules._comment: PATTERN 4: Sub-account to sub-account — pull excess above threshold, keep minimum
transferRules.label: Pull excess from Sub1 to Sub2

transferRules._comment: PATTERN 5: Sub-account to sub-account — top-up Sub3 from Sub2 when Sub3 runs low
transferRules.label: Top-up Sub3 from Sub2
